newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open lower, Nomura ask-only.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open lower, Nomura ask-only.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Friday, with the key market index under selling pressure.
Market attention stayed fixed on shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd, which were quoted ask-only at the opening.
Nomura said on Thursday that two of its executives were involved in apparently irregular deals with a corporate client.
After 35 minutes of trade the Nikkei 225 average was down 136.36 points or 0.76 percent at 17,904.97. Its March futures had lost 120 points to 17,900.

Nomura shares traded 50 yen lower at 1,530 yen, after being ask-only at the opening. Their volume of 3.142 million shares was the second-heaviest trade on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"Bearish sentiment was carried over from yesterday and it was hurt a little by news on Nomura," said a foreign securities house trader. The market was also weighed down by profit-taking before corporate book closings at the end of March, he said.
